name: Summoning
description: Elementalist Technique, based on Stamina, of drawing elements, animals or elementals from the surrounding area; costs a long-term Fatigue level.

name: Controlling
description: Elementalist Technique based on Presence that lets an elementalist dictate the behavior of summoned or encountered targets via gesture and incantation.

name: Divining
description: Elementalist Technique based on Perception used to locate and commune with elements and elemental targets; costs no Fatigue.

name: Refining
description: Elementalist Technique taking a season of lab-like work to purify or break down a target, often yielding raw vis.

name: Elementalist Air
description: Elementalist Form for air; associated with the sanguine temperament and yields Auram vis.

name: Elementalist Earth
description: Elementalist Form for earth; associated with the melancholic temperament.

name: Elementalist Fire
description: Elementalist Form for fire; associated with choleric temperament and produces Ignem vis when Refining.

name: Elementalist Water
description: Elementalist Form for water; yields Aquam vis when Refining.

name: Elementalist Arts
description: The Techniques and Forms of elementalist magic, traditionally said to have been developed by Apollonius of Tyana and his followers.

name: Theurgical Summoning
description: Virtue granting Summoning of elementals from pure base material.

name: Theurgical Controlling
description: Virtue letting an elemental theurgist command supernatural beings with Might of the appropriate element.

name: Philosophical Summoning
description: Virtue for conjuring natural phenomena, matter, or animals of an element; taught by Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Philosophical Refining
description: Major Virtue letting an elemental philosopher extract and move vis; gained via the Blood Oath of Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Medicinal Summoning
description: Virtue for altering bodily humors to cure or cause disease; taught by Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Medicinal Divining
description: Virtue for sensing imbalanced humors and diagnosing illness; taught by Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Elemental Medicine
description: Major background Virtue of elemental physicians; acquired through the Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character.

name: Elemental Philosophiae
description: Major background Virtue of elemental philosophers, acquired through the Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable.

name: Elemental Theurgy
description: Special background Virtue of elemental theurgists that could be converted into a Hermetic Virtue with a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Elemental Magic
description: Hermetic Virtue already possessed by some magi; might be an Outer Mystery of a Hermetic Elementalist cult.

name: Affinity with Controlling
description: Virtue possessed by Elisavet improving her Controlling Art.

name: Educated
description: Virtue common among Tulab Ibn Sina; allows Islamic characters to allocate experience to Arabic, Theology (Islam) and more.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Virtue frequently possessed by Tulab Ibn Sina members.

name: Famous
description: Virtue frequently possessed by Tulab Ibn Sina members.

name: Privileged Upbringing
description: Virtue frequently possessed by Tulab Ibn Sina members.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue frequently possessed by Tulab Ibn Sina members.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Virtue frequently possessed by Tulab Ibn Sina members.

name: Wealthy
description: Virtue letting a folk witch spend three seasons a year on laboratory activities; common among Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue frequently possessed by Tulab Ibn Sina members.

name: Folk Witch
description: Free Social Status Virtue for characters trained as folk witches, allowing potions, folk witch casting methods and coven membership.

name: Cursing
description: Major Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability letting a folk witch cast curses via fetishes or potions; Form depends on the curse.

name: Healing
description: Major Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability for true healing of wounds and Fatigue, breaking the Limit of Energy at a Corpus vis cost.

name: Life-Linked Folk Witch Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a folk witch spend Fatigue levels to boost her Casting Total by 5 each.

name: Animal Healer
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting the Animal Healing Ability, which heals animals using Animal vis.

name: Concentrated Potions
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a folk witch to use up to four times her Folk Witch Magic Theory in vis when brewing.

name: Expert Potion Brewer
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue doubling the Supernatural Ability in the Lab Total when brewing potions.

name: Flight
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability to fly, using Stamina and Auram, via fetish (broom) or potion.

name: Painless Moon
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: the folk witch suffers no Medium Wound during her Witch's Moon.

name: Well-Trained Folk Witch
description: Minor General Virtue granting 50 extra experience points during folk witch apprenticeship.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Major Hermetic Virtue suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Adept Laboratory Student
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Cyclic Magic (positive)
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Fast Caster
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Free Study
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Harnessed Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Inventive Genius
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Magical Memory
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Side Effect
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Special Circumstances
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Outcast
description: Flaw possessed by the elementalist Elisavet.

name: Meddler
description: Major Flaw possessed by Elisavet.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Being
description: Flaw possessed by Elisavet.

name: Infamous
description: Flaw possessed by Elisavet.

name: Vulnerable to (Form)
description: Elementalist Flaw, e.g. Vulnerable to Elementalist Earth, possibly received from a flawed Opening of society Arts.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Elementalist/Hermetic Flaw a student may receive from an inadequate Opening; also suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Weak Elementalist Resistance
description: Major Flaw gained through the Blood Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Mentor
description: Minor Flaw gained from initiation; the mentor is the initiation sponsor.

name: Study Requirement
description: Major Flaw acquired from the highest initiations of Ikhwan as-Safa' and Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Restriction
description: Major Flaw (e.g. cannot affect himself) gained from the Rite of Testing the Physician's Dedication; also a Major Hermetic Flaw for folk witches.

name: Vow
description: Minor Flaw requiring the character to find and train a suitable student in the Tulab Ibn Sina tradition.

name: Visions
description: Flaw acquired through the Rite of Opening the Mind.

name: Driven
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Higher Purpose
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Obsessed
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Oversensitive
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Pious
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Temperate
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Poor
description: Flaw limiting a folk witch to one season of laboratory activity per year.

name: Folk Witch Gift Opening
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: a Gifted folk witch's Opening failed to favor one of the seven folk witch Supernatural Abilities.

name: Primitive Tradition
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch cannot brew potions.

name: Rarefied Tradition
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch can only use Supernatural Abilities via potions.

name: Harsh Moon
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch suffers a Heavy Wound during each Witch's Moon.

name: Short-Ranged Curses
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: curse fetishes only work within 100 yards of the target.

name: Silent Tradition
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch cannot use the incantation casting method.

name: Unstable Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: folk witch lab creations decay after a year and a day.

name: Poorly Trained Folk Witch
description: Minor General Flaw: 50 fewer apprenticeship experience points.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Major Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Difficult Longevity Ritual
description: Major Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Major Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Painful Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Rigid Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Waster of Vis
description: Major Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Creative Block
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Cyclic Magic (negative)
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Disorientating Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Susceptibility to Divine Power
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Unimaginative Learner
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Warped Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Weak Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Weird Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw listed as suitable for Gifted folk witches.

name: Animal Ken
description: Folk witch Supernatural Ability (Communication, Animal) used via incantation or potion; grants Magical Fortitude and Accelerated Expiry defenses.

name: Dowsing
description: Folk witch Supernatural Ability (Perception) used via fetish rod or potion, important for finding vis.

name: Second Sight
description: Folk witch Supernatural Ability (Perception, Vim) used by incantation or potion.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Folk witch Supernatural Ability (Stamina, Animal) using an enchanted animal skin fetish or potion.

name: Animal Healing
description: Supernatural Ability granted by Animal Healer that heals animals using Animal vis.

name: Folk Witch Magic Theory
description: Arcane Ability analogous to Magic Theory, covering the technical details of folk witch magic and used in lab activities.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic Arcane Ability; elementalists use other Abilities instead of it for Refining.

name: Medicine
description: Ability added by elemental physicians to Refining Totals; core to Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability required for Tulab Ibn Sina initiations.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic Ability added to Philosophical Refining Totals and required by Ikhwan as-Safa' grades.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability required by Ikhwan as-Safa' and Tulab Ibn Sina initiations.

name: Theology (Islam)
description: Academic Ability required for the fourth grade of the Brethren of Purity and for Tulab Ibn Sina rites.

name: Arabic
description: Language Ability required for Ikhwan as-Safa' grades and Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Islamic Law
description: Ability equivalent to Canon Law in the West, available to Educated characters in Islamic lands.

name: (Realm) Lore
description: Arcane Ability added by elemental theurgists to Refining Totals and studied secretly by the Brethren.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability; Elisavet has it with specialty elementals.

name: Organization Lore: Brethren of Purity
description: Organization Lore Ability known by all Brethren of Purity.

name: Organization Lore: Students of Avicenna
description: Organization Lore Ability focused on by Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Organization Lore: Folk Witch
description: Ability used to recognize a folk witch's mark.

name: Apostles of Apollonius Lore
description: Organization lore Ability possessed by Elisavet.

name: Mediterranean Sea Lore
description: Area Lore Ability possessed by Elisavet.

name: Premonitions
description: Supernatural Ability acquired through the Rite of Opening the Mind.

name: Penetration
description: Ability for overcoming Magic Resistance; recommended for folk witches.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used to maintain control and recall lost incantations.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability recommended for folk witches.

name: Profession (Scribe)
description: Ability useful to a literate folk witch copying texts.

name: Athletics
description: Ability used for complex flying maneuvers.

name: Mythic Alchemy
description: Learned magic known by many Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Mythic Herbalism
description: Learned magic known by some Ikhwan as-Safa' and Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form of water; fire elementals seek out Aquam vis.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form of air; used by Flight and flying-aid enchantment.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire; Refining with Elementalist Fire yields Ignem vis.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form used for Second Sight and folk witch vis extraction.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form used for Healing and many curses.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form used by emotion and tongue curses.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form used for Animal Ken, Shapeshifter and beast curses.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique; Intellego vis is used to enchant a dowsing rod.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique; Rego Mentem magic used to enslave folk witches.

name: Elisavet
description: Apostle of Apollonius elemental theurgist, 51, exiled daughter of a Hermetic advisor, living on a Mediterranean island with a bound air elemental.

name: Apollonius of Tyana
description: First-century miracle worker whom elementalists believe first developed the Elementalist Arts.

name: Flavius Philostratus
description: Third-century biographer of Apollonius of Tyana.

name: Ibn Sina
aliases: Abu Ali al-Hussain Ibn Abdallah Ibn Sina
description: Abu Ali al-Hussain Ibn Abdallah Ibn Sina (b. 980 near Bukhara), Gifted physician and founder of the Tulab Ibn Sina; entombed in Hamadan.

name: Sultan of Bukhara
description: Ruler cured by Ibn Sina who rewarded him with access to his library.

name: Empedocles
description: Greek teacher whose philosophy influenced the first elementalists.

name: Galen
description: Greek teacher whose philosophy influenced the first elementalists.

name: Pythagoras
description: Greek teacher whose philosophy influenced the first elementalists.

name: Socrates
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Plato
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Aristotle
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Plotinus
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Euclid
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Ptolemy
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Porphyry
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Iamblichus
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Hippocrates
description: Ancient physician whose teachings Ibn Sina combined with Persian, Arab and Indian magic.

name: Nero
description: Roman emperor in whose last years Apollonius travelled through Rome and Iberia.

name: Apostles of Apollonius
description: Elementalist society teaching Theurgical Summoning and Controlling; ascetic, pious summoners rare but found across Mythic Europe in 1220.

name: Ikhwan as-Safa'
description: Brethren of Purity: secretive tenth-century Isma'ili fraternity from Basra teaching Philosophical Summoning and Refining through four grades.

name: Tulab Ibn Sina
description: Students of Avicenna: elementalist tradition of accomplished Islamic physicians teaching Medicinal Summoning and Divining.

name: Elementalist Societies
description: Groups of likeminded elementalists sharing particular Techniques and Forms; initiating members via Mystery Cult rules.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic order; generally regards elementalists and folk witches as curiosities of little threat.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House that Gifted elementalists would likely be invited to join.

name: House Criamon
description: Criamon magi near the Cave of Twisting Shadows support a group of Apostles of Apollonius.

name: House Tytalus
description: Tytalus magi in a story seed who enslaved a folk witch coven to brew Fatigue potions.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Bonisagus magi might have researched folk witch Fatigue potions.

name: House Tremere
description: Tremere certamen masters might suspect the Tytalus cabal.

name: Isma'ili
description: Sect of Shi'i Islam to which the founders of the Brethren of Purity belonged; oppressed in many areas.

name: The Church
description: Frowns upon folk witches as pagan remnants but largely ignores them.

name: Coven
description: Small localized group of folk witches, usually an elder mother and daughters.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Cult through which elementalists learn additional Techniques; may guard elementalist discoveries.

name: Hermetic Elementalist
description: Possible Hermetic mystery cult for which Elemental Magic may be an Outer Mystery.

name: Elementalist
description: Hedge wizard practising elemental magic through Elementalist Techniques and Forms.

name: Elemental Physician
description: Elementalist of the Medicinal type who manipulates bodily humors.

name: Elemental Philosopher
description: Elementalist of the Philosophical type who conjures natural phenomena, matter and animals.

name: Elemental Theurgist
description: Elementalist of the Theurgical type who summons and commands elementals.

name: Folk Witch
description: Widespread, mostly unGifted hedge tradition of village witches using potions, incantations and fetishes.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magician.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator whose ratification may be needed for Order membership.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard.

name: Elemental
description: Supernatural being summoned from base material; does not recover Might except by eating vis and reverts when Might is spent.

name: Fire Elemental
description: Elemental of fire; prefers to consume Aquam vis.

name: Air Elemental
description: Elemental of air, e.g. with Auram powers; Elisavet has one bound to a tree.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Elemental of earth with Terram powers.

name: Water Elemental
description: Elemental of water.

name: Familiar
description: A folk witch's familiar can assist her in her kitchen.

name: Humors
description: The four bodily humors (blood, black bile, yellow bile, phlegm) manipulated by elemental physicians.

name: Temperament
description: Dominant temperament of animals and people (choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic, sanguine) linked to elements.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power, in pawns of a Form; produced, consumed and moved by elementalists and folk witches.

name: Might
description: Measure of supernatural beings' power; elementals' Might Pool can be drained or restored.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that elementalist and folk witch effects must penetrate.

name: Aura
description: Local supernatural aura added to elementalist and folk witch totals.

name: Summoning Circle
description: Magical container traced by an elementalist to bind a summoned target.

name: Longevity Potion
description: Elementalist or folk-witch potion similar to a Hermetic longevity ritual giving a bonus to Aging rolls.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Hermetic ritual Elisavet seeks.

name: Opening the Gift
description: Mechanism by which a Gifted student is opened to a tradition's favored Arts or Abilities.

name: Opening Total
description: Total (Intelligence + highest Technique + lowest Form + aura) used to open society Arts.

name: The Gift
description: Innate magical talent; its social effects forced Ibn Sina to travel and cause suspicion of Gifted folk witches.

name: Initiation
description: Mystery process by which unGifted members gain Arts and Virtues via Scripts.

name: Initiation Script
description: Structured initiation with Ease Factor and Script Bonus (Quest, Ordeal, etc.).

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Code of the Order; covenants accuse each other of breaking it.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: Oath sworn to join the Order of Hermes.

name: Tribunal
description: Hermetic court where disputes like the elementalist case are adjudicated.

name: Hermetic Integration
description: Translating elementalist or folk witch magic into Hermetic theory via breakthroughs.

name: Minor Breakthrough
description: Research breakthrough converting elementalist Virtues into Hermetic Virtues.

name: Major Breakthrough
description: Research breakthrough adapting an Elementalist Art to Hermetic magic.

name: Outer Mystery
description: Mystery known outside a cult; Elemental Magic may be one.

name: Limit of Energy
description: Hermetic limit on restoring Fatigue, broken by folk witch potions and Healing.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel won secretly by the Tytalus cabal using Fatigue potions.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic ritual of Magic Resistance a beast-cursed magus cannot perform.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Protective effect whose Magic Resistance affects curse penetration.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target required for folk witch curses; folk witches can prolong its lifetime.

name: Warping
description: Warping Points gained by folk witches on botches.

name: Sabbat
description: Rare meeting of folk witch covens during which witches may assist one another.

name: Folk Witch Casting Methods
description: Potion, Incantation, and Fetish methods folk witches use for Supernatural Abilities.

name: Potion
description: Folk witch casting method; brewed batches granting abilities, with Brew Potency.

name: Incantation
description: Folk witch casting method of reciting a rhyming poem the target must hear.

name: Fetish
description: Item a folk witch must hold to use an Ability, prepared in a season of lab work.

name: Brew Potency
description: The Lab Total of a potion, used as its Casting Total base.

name: Witch's Mark
description: Each folk witch's mark revealing her effects, like a magus' sigil.

name: Magical Defenses
description: Limited defenses folk witches gain from each power instead of Magic Resistance.

name: Magical Fortitude
description: Magic Defense from Animal Ken and Healing.

name: Accelerated Expiry
description: Magic Defense from Animal Ken and Second Sight.

name: Confounding Magics
description: Magic Defense from Dowsing against Mentem effects.

name: Immovable Object
description: Magic Defense from Flight against Corpus effects.

name: Strength of Form
description: Magic Defense from Shapeshifter against Animal or Corpus effects.

name: Witch's Moon
description: Monthly period in which a folk witch suffers a wound and may be unable to use her abilities.

name: Witch's Kitchen
description: Folk witch equivalent of a laboratory, built around a cauldron.

name: Lab Text
description: Laboratory notes; folk witch Lab Texts are of no use to magi.

name: Laboratory
description: Hermetic laboratory; cannot be used by folk witches without conversion.

name: Experimentation
description: Folk witches may experiment with lab activities using the Extraordinary Results table.

name: Vis Extraction
description: Extracting Vim vis from an aura; done by elemental philosophers and folk witches.

name: Curse Fetish Weaving
description: Weaving a curse fabric on a loom over a season with an Arcane Connection.

name: Dowsing Rod
description: Fetish for Dowsing; enchanted with 1 pawn of Intellego vis.

name: Flight Broom
description: Flying aid fetish (broom, bucket, etc.) enchanted with 1 pawn of Auram vis.

name: Skin Knitting
description: Enchanting an animal skin fetish for Shapeshifting using Animal vis.

name: Curse of Disease
description: Folk witch curse (EF 9) inflicting fevered disease and a Medium Wound.

name: Curse of Miscarriage
description: Folk witch curse (EF 9) that may make a pregnant woman miscarry.

name: Curse of Aging
description: Folk witch curse (EF 12) causing an immediate Aging Crisis.

name: Curse of Emotion
description: Folk witch curse (EF 12) making the target feel strong emotion toward someone.

name: Curse of the Tongue
description: Folk witch curse (EF 15) making the target forget all languages.

name: Curse of Paralysis
description: Folk witch curse (EF 15) preventing movement of limbs.

name: Curse of the Beast
description: Folk witch curse (EF 18) turning the target into a small animal.

name: Curse of Reduction
description: Folk witch curse (EF 18) reducing target Size monthly.

name: Blood Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'
description: Initiation Script granting Philosophical Refining and Weak Elementalist Resistance.

name: Ritual of Uncovering the Elemental Nature of Man
description: Ikhwan as-Safa' Script granting an Elementalist Form tied to humor, and the Mentor Flaw.

name: Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable
description: Ikhwan as-Safa' Script granting Elemental Philosophiae and Study Requirement.

name: Rite of Testing the Physician's Dedication
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script granting Medicinal Divining and Restriction.

name: Ritual of Discovering the Physician's Humor
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script granting an Elementalist Form and Vow.

name: Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character
aliases: Ritual of Refining the Physician's Character
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script granting Elemental Medicine and Study Requirement.

name: Rite of Opening the Mind
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script at Ibn Sina's tomb granting Premonitions and Visions.

name: Grades of the Brethren
description: Four grades of the Brethren of Purity requiring increasing Ability scores.

name: Islam
description: Religion of the Brethren of Purity and Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Aging Crisis
description: Crisis ending a longevity potion's effect; triggered by Curse of Aging.

name: Folk Witch Apprenticeship
description: Ten-year training by a coven granting 200 experience points.

name: Epistles of the Brethren of Purity and Loyal Friends
aliases: Rasa'il Ikhwan as-Safa' wa Khillan al-Wafa
description: 52 letters in four books serving as tractatus and, with the Comprehensive Epistle, summae on Elementalist Arts.

name: The Comprehensive Epistle
description: Al-Risala al-Jami'a, key to the Epistles; a Philosophiae summa and summa for Philosophical Refining.

name: Mathematical Sciences
description: Book One of the Epistles; Artes Liberales tractatus and Elementalist Air summa.

name: Natural Sciences
description: Book Two of the Epistles; Philosophiae tractatus and Elementalist Water summa.

name: Psychological and Rational Sciences
description: Book Three of the Epistles; summa for Elementalist Fire.

name: Theological Sciences
description: Book Four of the Epistles; Theology (Islam) tractatus and Elementalist Earth summa.

name: Al-Qanun fil-Tibb
description: Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine, summa on Medicine and Medicinal Divining.

name: Kitab ash-Shifa
description: Ibn Sina's Book of Healing; summa on Artes Liberales and the four Elementalist Forms.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting in 1220.

name: Basra
description: Persian city where Ikhwan as-Safa' was founded.

name: Bukhara
description: Persian city near which Ibn Sina was born.

name: Hamadan
description: Persian city with the tomb of Ibn Sina.

name: Tomb of Ibn Sina
description: Site in Hamadan where supplicants of the Rite of Opening the Mind fast.

name: Cave of Twisting Shadows
description: Place in the Greater Alps near which Criamon magi support Apostles of Apollonius.

name: Greater Alps
description: Tribunal region with a village of Apostles of Apollonius.

name: Levant
description: Region where elementalists and Brethren are present.

name: Andalusia
description: Region where the Brethren of Purity are present.

name: North Africa
description: Region where the Brethren of Purity are present.

name: Mediterranean
description: Sea where Elisavet's island lies.

name: Asia Minor
description: Where Apollonius formed his circle.

name: Alexandria
description: Visited by Apollonius in 69 AD.

name: Rome
description: Apollonius faced trial there in 93.

name: Babylon
description: Source of ancient wizards' elemental magic.

name: Italy
description: Destination of Elisavet's banishment.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal near which theurgical magic is common.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Tribunal near which theurgical magic is common.
